title: Slope
preview: Slope as constant rate of change, slope of a line from a graph or point and slope, and direct variation.
description: Indiana standards 7.AF.5, 7.AF.6. Students connect proportional relationships from earlier units to the formal idea of slope and direct variation.

sections.label: 12-1 Proportional Relationships and Slope
sections.description: Define slope as vertical change per unit of horizontal change; connect to constant rate of change.

sections.label: 12-2 Slope of a Line
sections.description: Graph a line given its slope and a point; find slope from a graph.

sections.label: 12-4 Direct Variation
sections.description: Recognise and graph direct variation y = kx.
